## Runtime vs. IMDb Rating

This page explores the relationship between movie runtime and IMDb ratings. As shown in @fig-runtime-rating, the scatter plot compares the runtime of each film with its IMDb rating.

::: {#cell-fig-runtime-rating .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (Minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb Rating")
plt.title("Runtime vs. IMDb Rating")
plt.show()
```

## Average IMDb Rating by Decade

The following table shows the average IMDb rating of films grouped by decade.

::: {#439b3467 .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
```
